basic_profile.bio: A passionate homebrewer from Denver, Colorado, who has been perfecting the art of beer-making for just over a year and a half. When not experimenting with new recipes, I work as a graphic designer. I'm usually online during the evenings after work, especially on weekends when I can dedicate more time to brewing. In a committed relationship with a fellow craft beer enthusiast, we often explore local breweries together. I enjoy learning about new techniques and sharing my brewing successes and failures with the community. Not a fan of overly commercialized beer, I prefer unique flavors and small-batch brews.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Self-taught homebrewer who started out by reading books and online forums, followed by hands-on experimentation. Regularly watches brewing videos and attends local workshops to enhance skills. As a graphic designer, I occasionally design labels for my own brews and for friends.
